GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (2 May 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 915)
APO 500
2 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Viscount OKOCHI, Masatoshi.
1. Viscount OKOCHI, Masatoshi, incarcerated in Sugamo Prison 16 December 1945 for investigation, has been released unconditionally as of 26 April 1946.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
